en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing domed white roofs and an ornate entrance of an Islamic mosque with intricate arches and decorative carvings. A tall minaret rises in the background against a hillside cityscape of dense buildings. Printed French text at the top identifies the view as Oran – La Mosquée du Pacha, and a small publisher credit appears in the lower right corner.
